overview: Arena Ally is a social sports app that fights the loneliness epidemic by using sports as a bridge to genuine connection. It tracks your Social Battery (group vs solo activity balance), offers gamified Team Objectives to complete together with others, and provides an AI wellness coach that adapts to your activity patterns and flags burnout risk.
features: Internet Identity login with protected routes
Social Battery dashboard with score, activity log, and well-being risk flag
Log group or solo activities to update your score in real time
Gamified Team Objectives with progress bars and reward badges
AI Wellness Coach powered by OpenAI (admin-set shared key) with rule-based fallback
Profile page: view and edit sport preferences
Sample demo content pre-populated so the app feels alive immediately
